name: chapter-numeral-roman
title: Chapter Numeral Roman
description: Chapter openers with an oversized roman numeral set behind the title as a ghost layer — the numeral clips through the heading on scroll using a background-attached gradient, so text passes over it like a watermark.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Scroll Clip: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
